output.population: Patients with pathologically confirmed breast cancer, candidates for primary systemic (neoadjuvant) therapy, with planned surgical resection of residual primary tumor after neoadjuvant therapy.
output.summary: PET imaging collection from ACRIN 6688 using [18F]-fluorothymidine to evaluate the relationship between FLT uptake parameters and pathologic complete response to neoadjuvant therapy in locally advanced breast cancer.
